sections.advice: Arusha → Lake Manyara is 124 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Lake Manyara → Ngorongoro Crater rim climbs about 2300 m in 54 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ngorongoro Crater rim → Olduvai Gorge drops about 2300 m over 40 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Olduvai Gorge → Seronera is 106 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Lake Manyara → Ngorongoro Crater rim
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 94 km. 2300 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Ngorongoro Crater rim → Olduvai Gorge
scenicChapters.narrative: 2300 m come off over 68 km at around 5.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

tanzania-ngorongoro-and-serengeti-route.story: From Arusha it runs 560 km to the finish; allow about 7 h 36 of riding. It goes by way of Lake Manyara, Ngorongoro Crater rim and Olduvai Gorge. The highest point is about 2,300 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
